ValidationRule.description: Blocks DE Sales users editing an Account once finance approval starts (DnB/KYC/Legal pending, Approved, Rejected). Draft (blank/Not_Required/Not_Started) stays editable. Only DE Sales profile; Account_Edit_Finance_Bypass perm exempts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name = "DE Sales", NOT($Permission.Account_Edit_Finance_Bypass), OR( ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "DnB_Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "KYC_Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "Legal_Review_Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "Rejected_DnB"), ISPICKVAL(Finance_Approval_Phase__c, "Rejected_KYC") ), OR( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Company_Code__c), ISCHANGED(Account_Manager__c), ISCHANGED(Preferred_Language__c), ISCHANGED(Local_Language__c), ISCHANGED(Local_Entity_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Terms__c), ISCHANGED(Local_Registered_Office_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Operation_Country__c), ISCHANGED(Primary_Contact__c), ISCHANGED(DE_Entity__c), ISCHANGED(Registered_Address__c), ISCHANGED(Tax_ID__c), ISCHANGED(Tax_Exemption_Status__c), ISCHANGED(VAT_Number__c), ISCHANGED(UEN__c), ISCHANGED(Credit_Limit_MRC__c), ISCHANGED(Credit_Limit_NRC__c), ISCHANGED(Credit_Block__c), ISCHANGED(Overdue_90_Days__c), ISCHANGED(Security_Deposit_Required__c), ISCHANGED(Security_Deposit_Invoice_Ref__c), ISCHANGED(Security_Deposit_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(BillingStreet), ISCHANGED(BillingCity), ISCHANGED(BillingState), ISCHANGED(BillingCountry), ISCHANGED(BillingPostalCode),
ISCHANGED(Entity_Locked__c), ISCHANGED(Finance_Approval_Phase__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This account is in (or past) finance approval, so Sales can no longer edit it. Please contact Finance if a change is required.
